To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the structure of words used in linked pages is a better indicator for relevance of the indexed page than the structure of links to or from the target page, and (ii) the structure of the word usage in pages linked at a distance 2 from the indexed page is more relevant than the structure of word usage in pages that are linked directly to the indexed page.

(i) the structure of words used in the linked pages can be used to identify the words that are most likely to be relevant to the indexed page and (ii) the analysis of the structure of words can be done using bots that are able to analyze content of web pages and identify the words used in them.

(a) a structure of words in the linked pages can be used for indexing; (b) the structure of words in linked pages can be efficiently analyzed; (c) a structure of the linked pages is a good indicator of the quality of the page of interest; and (d) the structure of the words in linked pages enables more precise indexing.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for indexing and searching web pages based on a new type of bots that analyze content of the linked pages.
a new method for indexing web pages.
the problem of automatic indexing of web documents.

our method is capable of indexing web pages in a more effective manner than the current state of the art.
our method is capable of indexing a page based on the words used by pages that are linked to or from it.
the method described in this paper is a novel method for indexing web pages.

we have demonstrated that a new method of indexing web pages based on the structure of words used in the pages linked to the page of interest is more efficient than the current indexing methods.

the content of linked pages is a valuable resource for indexing web pages.
